g.text: Off by default. The approved command runs once, unchanged. RTK filters its captured output
inside an empty, network-denied sandbox. Authority, Sentinel, approvals and file revocations
Original output stays private and is linked by SHA-256 to the command receipt. Savings are
byte/4 estimates, not provider billing or tokenizer measurements. A changed binary needs a new
Enter send · Ctrl+J newline · Esc back · Ctrl+P commands · Ctrl+B sidebar
